newsitem.title: USA: Micron Electronics up on deal rumors.
newsitem.headline: Micron Electronics up on deal rumors.

text.p: Shares of Micron Electronics Inc rose sharply after PC Week Online reported that the Idaho-based mail-order computer company has been approached about a possible merger.
Micron Electronics shares rose 1-1/8 to 23-1/2 and traders also reported a second straight day of heavy activity in options.
A spokesman for Micron Electronics declined to comment, citing company policy. The company is an affiliate of Micron Technology Inc, which owns about 80 percent.
PC Week Online reported late Tuesday that Micron Technology has held preliminary discussions to sell the unit to Hewlett-Packard Co, Sanyo Electric Co Ltd and Gateway 2000 Inc.
A Micron Technology spokesman was not immediately available for comment. Micron Electronics was formed in 1995 from the merger of Zeos International Ltd and two Micron Technology units.
The report in PC Week Online comes amid widespread speculation about the mail-order computer sector.
